propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache accounts for 92% (≈950 MiB of 1.04 GiB) of the tickets branch size due to timestamp and rotation bookkeeping fields that are not read by the codebase.

The baseline_advanced_at field (written at binding_store.py:375, never read in src/) and last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping cause 1,144 and 20 entries to change per reconciler pass in a 18 MB bindings.json file, defeating git delta compression and resulting in 12.79 KB marginal cost per version.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp reduces marginal pack cost to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement); moving last_get_pass to a separate file halves version churn (12.8x total improvement toward target of ≤25% of baseline).

A one-time history reclaim using git fast-export/filter-import pipeline reduces the branch from 1.17 GiB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and restoring byte-identical HEAD tree.

The rollout requires mixed-version read/write compatibility, descendant workflow execution gates, explicit epoch guards at both union sites, and operator-attested quiescence with off-repo bundle backup before publication and reclaim execution.
